remarks:
Welcome to this brand-new 1,250 sq. ft. ranch, ideally situated at the end of a quiet dead-end street in
Blasdell. Enjoy the convenience of Town of Hamburg taxes and the highly desirable Frontier Central
School District. This thoughtfully designed single-story home will feature 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, with a modern, functional layout designed for comfortable everyday living. New construction provides buyers with the opportunity to enjoy a brand-new home without the maintenance and updating typically associated with older properties. The location offers a great combination of privacy and convenience, tucked away at the end of the street while remaining close to shopping, restaurants, schools, and major routes throughout the Southtowns. Property Highlights include: Brand-new construction, Approximately 1,250 sq. ft., 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, Single-story ranch design, Located at the end of a dead-end street, Town of Hamburg taxes, Frontier Central School District, Architectural drawings included with the listing, Reference photos included to illustrate the anticipated style and appearance of the completed home
A great opportunity to own an affordable, newly constructed ranch in a desirable Blasdell location. Not too
many vacant lots available in the Hamburg area.
